tail.severe_loss: candidate code_file_hint_recall is 0 at any budget where the comparator's is above 0

rule.unit: task; each task's 5 attempts per arm are averaged, and the 20 task means are paired across arms

primary.aggregation: mean list-price estimate over every attempt, including failed and capped ones
primary.hypothesis: candidate costs less than the comparator
primary.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on comparator minus candidate

success.test: one-sided paired sign-flip non-inferiority on candidate minus comparator

secondary: pass^k for k = 1..5 (unbiased per-task estimator, averaged over tasks)
rule.completeness: every planned task x trial x arm must have a summary with complete usage; infrastructure aborts are rerun from scratch and their partial runs are kept outside the plan
rule.scope: synthetic fault-repair tasks are harness evidence, not natural held-out issues; a pass cannot authorize product promotion by itself
rule.multiplicity: both alphas are divided by the number of tested arms (candidates plus controls) in a batch
rule.comparators: a batch may list several comparators; a candidate passes only if it passes against every one (intersection-union, no alpha split across comparators)

localization_screen.units: tree-sitter (Go, Python, JavaScript): each outermost function, method, or function bound by a declaration, assignment, or object pair is one unit spanning its binding statement and decorators; every other line falls into 24-line module windows; non-code files use 24-line text windows

arms.graf_floor: graf locate --text --file-score damped --stop floor (agent batch t2/t3 candidate)
arms.graphify: pinned code-only Graphify extract + query at token_budget 2000; navigation hints
arms.file_bm25: BM25 over whole files, ranked paths, stop below 0.5 x best score; a lexical file-ranking proxy, not the search-only agent
arms.ast_units: BM25 (retrieval.terms, k1 1.2, b 0.75) over code units; whole units in score order, stop below 0.5 x best score or when the next unit does not fit; an over-long best unit is cut to the budget. Idea: cAST structural chunking (Zhang et al. 2025), Agentless function-level localization (Xia et al. 2024)
arms.ast_graph: ast_units with call-graph propagation: score + 0.5 x best neighbour score over undirected call edges between function units, linked by called name; names defined by more than 3 units are not linked. Idea: RepoGraph (Ouyang et al. 2025), LocAgent (Chen et al. 2025)
arms.ast_bounded: ast_units with function units longer than 24 lines split into 24-line pieces aligned to the function start (size-bounded structural chunks). Idea: cAST (Zhang et al. 2025); Wu et al. 2026 found unbounded function chunks worst
arms.graf_floor_ids: graf_floor with a deterministic rewritten query: the issue title plus code-like tokens from the body (file paths, dotted names, camelCase, PascalCase with an inner capital, snake_case and constants, called names, and identifiers inside backticks or code blocks), deduplicated in order; the raw issue if none. Idea: BLIZZARD (Rahman and Roy 2018), Caumartin and Melo 2026

Alternatives must be indexed ASCII alphabetic words with length5..64, same first4 bytes as original (also ASCII alphabetic length5..64), and Levenshtein distance<=1 when minimum word length<7, otherwise<=2. Enumerate only BTreeMap vocabulary prefix range, reject length differences above threshold before dynamic programming. At most4 alternatives per original term, sorted distance then lexical spelling; original never competes for cap. Per group/chunk use max(tf*0.5^distance) across original/alternatives, never summed frequencies. Compute IDF from union chunk df for that group and same existing BM25 length normalization. Group with no postings excluded. Multiply sum group BM25 scores by squared fraction of group IDF matched by each chunk. Stable score-descending/chunk-index ties. Original query still drives locate preview/best line and unit scores; no expansion in structural unit selection. Existing file collapse, candidate/limit/stop policy, scope/kind filters, equal-share structural evidence packing, source validation, fallback and range handles unchanged.
